scope: The page JavaScript prompt uses EditorControl with Rust/Metal editing and one native Textfield in the Views baseline. Existing origin/profile identity, frame/navigation/visibility cancellation, beforeunload defaults and asynchronous renderer reply ownership remain. UI acceptance guards preedit; editor/acceptance/close callbacks and keyboard posts carry a dialog generation. Explicit API override remains raw UTF-16 and is scoped to the manager WebContents.

build_input_snapshot.gn_delta: No target/dependency or Rust bridge change. Page dialog source/header, optional-fill editor API/implementations and browser tests changed. Native macOS routing now dispatches registered textless-dialog keys without inventing defaults or preempting active text clients.
build_input_snapshot.method: Committed archive with explicit prototype overrides, including page_dialogs.cc/h, and unchanged shared-service install/stage hooks, excluding concurrent root network-policy work. Final staging idempotent and Ninja no-work.

verification.coretext_geometry_raster_harness: Inherited matching 180-case font/direction and raster SDK evidence; unchanged source.
verification.python_scope: 66 tests from a clean committed archive; the live checkout passed 68, including two concurrent network/staging cases outside this UI commit.
verification.standalone_editor_model_scope: Inherited matching 61-case standalone model run; unchanged source.
verification.rust_unit_test_scope: Inherited matching 214-case Rust run; editor/scene/model and bridge Rust sources unchanged. Not repeated for this native adapter change.

ui_inventory.skip_reason: Four opt-in performance scenarios, the real-user Arc import and the interactive one-hour manual harness were not activated. Chromium launcher reports these GTest skips as SUCCESS; counts here normalize explicit SKIPPED lines.

editor_coverage: Actual Cocoa A/Return/Escape, Unicode initial/committed/composed answer, live Metal editor visibility without a native Textfield child, preserved dark parent mode, real fieldless confirm Return and alert Escape, field inside the computed long-message content bounds, and original client destruction after response.

Synthetic composing Return/Escape exercise application key policy separately from platform input-method filtering. A direct dialog accept while composing stays open; cancellation returns null and no marked response. A subsequent explicit confirmation and Cocoa Return deliver the final string to real renderer JavaScript.

Wrong-WebContents API override is rejected. Explicit override cancels preedit and preserves exact raw UTF-16 including NUL, CR/LF, emoji and Hebrew. Repeated answer/cancel requests cannot duplicate a callback.

A pending old-prompt key cannot accept a newly opened prompt after cancellation. Editor/acceptance/close callbacks capture the dialog generation. CLIENT_OWNS_WIDGET and MakeCloseSynchronous destroy the text client at answer time without waiting for native sheet animation. Forceful CloseNow automatically posts one negative response before any explicit manager cancellation. Repeated cancellation does not duplicate it or retain a dead field pointer. Test cleanup drains callbacks while fixture-bound stack state remains alive.

Hiding the originating workspace cancels a real renderer prompt without populating another page. Browser-initiated subframe navigation cancels its captured frame-owned prompt exactly once; the title still identifies the requesting frame origin.

A separate actual Cocoa beforeunload test asserts the native Cancel policy: macOS does not register Cancel as the Return default, so Return leaves the dialog/transaction open and Escape cancels. Both close attempts retain the tabs and original draft. Existing NativeJavaScriptDialogs, atomic close/restore/profile checks and other editor regressions remain included.
limits: This replaces prompt text input and boundary/admission adapters, not the Views modal title/buttons/profile/message labels/scroll/container or page dialog form/controller ownership.

All inventoried custom prototype fields use EditorControl in the opt-in backend; the folder DialogModel Textfield remains the intentional Views baseline. This source inventory does not prove all inherited Chromium UI has been migrated.

Actual OS candidate-window behavior, VoiceOver, broader native undo/menu/focus/hide sequences, complex bidi/pointer/scale/theme/GPU recovery and signed/manual app acceptance remain. Dark mode inheritance and default theme-color resolution are not a pixel/raster audit for every theme transition.
No end-to-end CPU/GPU/presentation speedup claimed. Four performance opt-ins, real-user Arc import and one-hour manual harness are explicitly skipped per backend.
Normal apps/profiles untouched. No new crate/library/dependency/license. Browser JavaScript, frame, profile and beforeunload authorization remain existing native services.

native_contract_notes.kill_buffer: The native Views buffer is now canonical for both backends, including fields that remain native. Get/Set borrow/copy UTF-16 only on the UI thread and never instantiate Textfield or RenderText. The prior separate Rust thread-local store was removed.
native_contract_notes.fork_integration: API installation is validated before staging writes, preserves unrelated native edits, is idempotent and rolls back partial failures. The report strips the exact service additions and verifies that both native tracked files equal their pinned originals.
native_contract_notes.ax_offsets: No accessibility behavior changed here. macOS VoiceOver acceptance remains open; Windows-only offset arrays are not a presumed missing macOS baseline requirement.

mac_cancel_default.rule: PlatformStyle::kDialogDefaultButtonCanBeCancel = !IS_MAC; DialogDelegate::GetIsDefault applies this rule even when GetDefaultDialogButton names Cancel.
mac_cancel_default.mac_behavior: Return does not activate Cancel; the dialog stays open. Escape cancels. This is intentional native semantics, not a missing accelerator.

modal_widget_ownership.rule: Pinned Widget API deprecates asynchronous Close/CloseWithReason in favor of CLIENT_OWNS_WIDGET and MakeCloseSynchronous. OnNativeWidgetDestroyed invokes the override for unexpected platform/parent destruction.

repairs: Replaced the page prompt allocation with the existing EditorControl adapter, retaining one true native baseline field and native default font metric.
Added optional background fill: nullopt resolves current theme colors in both editor adapters instead of freezing a resolved color for page dialogs.
Computed dialog content height from children with the existing 280 px minimum so a capped long message cannot push the answer field outside its content area.

Installed macOS standalone-window keyboard routing for page dialogs, including registered textless default/Escape accelerators; composing UI acceptance stays open and noncomposing keyboard actions are posted with generation/visibility/weak-owner guards.

Detached callbacks and canceled preedit on negative answers before closing, retained explicit automation override/confirmation, and made page and workspace-removal widgets client-owned with synchronous C++ lifetime and automatic negative response for forced native closure.
Dispatch registered native textless-dialog accelerators and preserve the macOS unbound-Return policy; consecutive real Cocoa Escape cancellations retain the tabs and draft.

native_service_patch.license: Generated Chromium header and source hook retain the Chromium BSD-style license; project adapter/tool/model changes use Apache-2.0.

initial_build_issue.issue: Missing explicit ui/views/accessibility/view_accessibility.h include caused an incomplete-type compile error. Added the header before successful build; no failed GUI run from that draft.

initial_gate_issue.issue: The first fixture tried EvalJs on the personal page without navigating it. EvalJs reported a non-live frame (its generic already-crashed-frame message); this result alone does not establish a renderer crash. Both backends failed only that expectation.
initial_gate_issue.repair: Use the existing NavigateBoth fixture helper before prompt creation and cross-profile JavaScript isolation assertions. Production code unchanged for this repair.

beforeunload_policy_investigation.issue: The added test initially assumed that Return activates Cancel on macOS and timed out. This assumption was wrong; both backends follow the native platform rule.
beforeunload_policy_investigation.repair: Assert native GetIsDefault policy, require Return to leave the macOS dialog/transaction open, then send real Escape and verify draft/tab survival. The unsupported routing/type/logging experiments were discarded. A separate corrected-policy probe found a repeated Escape timeout on the native-only path; the final adapter dispatches only registered keys for textless dialogs, leaving unregistered Return unchanged.

repeat_escape_investigation.issue: After correcting the macOS Return assumption, a repeated dialog timed out on Escape (trace 27) in both backends with the native-only route.
repeat_escape_investigation.repair: All page dialogs install the existing standalone router. When no text client is active, registered Return/Escape accelerators are dispatched through the native FocusManager. A missing Return binding remains unhandled, preserving the native Cancel policy. Active text clients retain responder/IME precedence.

async_close_fixture_issue.issue: The first full 30-case gate passed Metal; Views failed an immediate old-client-expired expectation after RunUntilIdle. Widget Close is asynchronous, so idle alone did not prove client destruction.
async_close_fixture_issue.repair: Wait for actual old-client expiry and callback completion. Also generation-bind delegate/body/editor callbacks so late callbacks cannot target a replacement dialog. Force-close coverage waits for automatic response/client destruction before any explicit cancellation.

native_modal_lifetime_investigation.issue: First full run passed Metal; Views timed out waiting for old prompt clients and the existing workspace-deletion widget to die. Three failing cases passed with native modal animations disabled. Real foreground activation alone passed the three-case probe but failed two prompt-lifetime cases in the broader gate on both backends.
native_modal_lifetime_investigation.repair: Use Chromium-recommended CLIENT_OWNS_WIDGET plus MakeCloseSynchronous for page dialogs and workspace deletion confirmation in both backends. C++ editors/widgets now die at answer/cancel time while native AppKit animation remains asynchronous. Native forced/parent closure invokes the same once-only callback. The unbundled test fixture also uses Chromium real foreground/key-window activation. No final run disables modal animations.

additional_performance_scenario_coverage.purpose: Execute all four opt-in performance scenarios as additional automated coverage, with their default 30 trials. Metal validation is enabled; these are not controlled CPU/GPU/drawable presentation comparisons.
